editedExercise.name: Upper-Trapezius Neck Stretch

instructions.description: Sit or stand tall with your spine in a neutral position. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your arms resting comfortably at your sides.
Slowly tilt your head to one side, bringing your ear gently toward the same-side shoulder. Keep both shoulders relaxed and down.
Keep your chin facing forward without rotating or tipping your head. Hold the stretch in a comfortable position and breathe slowly and steadily.
Slowly return your head to the center without making any sudden movements. Repeat the stretch on the opposite side for the designated duration.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Upper-Trapezius Neck Stretch — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Use only light head weight; do not pull forcefully.
Breathe naturally and avoid holding your breath.
You should feel a gentle stretch along the side of your neck and upper shoulder, not sharp or radiating pain.
